# Soliton Power

> Soliton Power is a Vancouver, Canada group that builds and grows businesses. It runs six specialist companies in training, digital marketing, software, international trade, management consulting, and events and travel, and provides the leadership and operations behind them. Each company serves its own clients under its own brand.

Founder: Hos Movahedi. Contact: hello@solitonpower.com. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/soliton-power

People looking for a service should contact the company that fits. Soliton Power itself is the right contact for partnerships, new company ideas, or help choosing the right company.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.solitonpower.com/): what Soliton Power does, its companies, and examples of content, technical writing, analysis and software work
- [Companies](https://www.solitonpower.com/companies): overview of all six companies
- [About us](https://www.solitonpower.com/about): how the group works and the founder
- [Contact](https://www.solitonpower.com/contact): partnerships, ideas and general enquiries

## Consulting with Hos Movahedi

- [Consulting with Hos](https://www.solitonpower.com/consulting): direct consulting from Soliton Power's founder for startups and small businesses growing in Canada and the US, especially from the Middle East and North Africa, South America and South Asia. Services: startup consulting, buying or selling a business, company valuation, business analysis, marketing analysis, trade and import to the US and Canada, administrative and operational support. Entry point: a 90-minute intro call for $200 USD, booked at https://calendly.com/hos-solitonpower/30min. Larger virtual or in-person business analysis projects use a team (financial analyst, management consultant, CPHR, lawyer, software engineer) and are quoted per project.
- Background: international trade in Dubai and Vancouver (HDT Shipping Lines), tech and media startups in Vancouver (Paper Oni Productions), marketing in California (Estrada Consulting), higher education in Vancouver (Oxford International Colleges), operations, M&A and valuation (Skyra). LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/hos-movahedi-ab004563/

## Companies (live)

- [CTLS – Canada Training and Learning Systems](https://www.solitonpower.com/ctls): courses, training programs, instructional design and learning platforms (LMS) for colleges and organizations worldwide, delivered by verified Canadian professionals. Website: https://www.ctlservices.ca
- [Red Chair Marketing](https://www.solitonpower.com/red-chair-marketing): digital marketing for businesses in Vancouver, Whistler and Squamish: local SEO, websites, social media, e-commerce, content creation and merchandise. Website: https://www.redchairmarketing.ca
- [Tectostack](https://www.solitonpower.com/tectostack): senior-led custom software development from Vancouver: web apps, APIs, AI integration, cloud and DevOps. Fixed written quotes. Website: https://tectostack.com

## Companies (launching in 2027)

- [Soliton Trade Advising](https://www.solitonpower.com/soliton-trade-advising): trade, logistics and sales support for companies in Africa, MENA, Asia Pacific and South America importing into, partnering in or sourcing from Canada and the USA.
- [Soliton Management Services](https://www.solitonpower.com/soliton-management-services): boutique management consulting for small and medium-sized businesses in Vancouver: strategy, operations, financial analysis, organizational development and valuation.
- [PacificHeron](https://www.solitonpower.com/pacificheron): event and travel packages for corporate teams, families and groups, with planning, hosts and coordination for a 15% coordination charge.
